item.subject: science
item.stem: After Diwali, Meena's grandmother adds fallen leaves and vegetable peels to the compost pit behind their house in Nagpur. A few weeks later, most of this dead matter has broken down into dark soil-like material. Which organisms are mainly responsible for this breakdown?

options.A: earthworms only, which eat all the dead matter by themselves
options.B: decomposers such as fungi and bacteria, which feed on dead matter and waste
options.C: green plants, which absorb the dead matter through their roots
options.D: birds and insects, which carry the dead matter away to their nests
